info.title: GratisAPI
info.summary: A completely free, static, open-data API.
info.description: GratisAPI is served entirely from static files. Every path below resolves to a real, clean, extension-less URL you can `curl` or `fetch` directly — for example `GET /api/animals/lion` — with no authentication, no rate limits, no keys and no cost. Only HTTP GET is supported. Large generated families (numbers, unicode blocks, calendars, times tables, math sequences) are omitted here for brevity — see /api/index for the full catalog.
